name: io.github.mario-andreschak/mcp-whatsapp-web
title: WhatsApp Web MCP Server
description: WhatsApp MCP via web.js or browserless Baileys: messages, media, chats, groups and contacts

environmentVariables.name: WHATSAPP_BACKEND
environmentVariables.description: WhatsApp backend: webjs uses a persistent browser profile; baileys connects without a browser and requires separate pairing

environmentVariables.name: BAILEYS_SESSION_DIR
environmentVariables.description: Baileys credentials and synchronized history directory (default: <working directory>/baileys-sessions). Use a private absolute path, owned by one server process.

environmentVariables.name: LOG_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level for the log file (logs/mcp-whatsapp.log)

environmentVariables.name: LOG_STDERR_LEVEL
environmentVariables.description: Log level for stderr (visible in most MCP client logs)

environmentVariables.name: WHATSAPP_HEADLESS
environmentVariables.description: webjs only: set to false to show the browser window instead of running headless

environmentVariables.name: WHATSAPP_NO_SANDBOX
environmentVariables.description: webjs only: explicitly disable the browser sandbox for containers that require it. The sandbox is enabled by default.

environmentVariables.name: BROWSER_EXECUTABLE_PATH
environmentVariables.description: webjs only: browser executable. Chrome and Edge are auto-detected; set this to use a specific browser. Chrome/Edge is required for sending videos and GIFs.

environmentVariables.name: WHATSAPP_SESSION_DIR
environmentVariables.description: webjs only: persistent browser profile directory (default: <working directory>/whatsapp-sessions)

environmentVariables.name: WHATSAPP_PAIRING_PHONE_NUMBER
environmentVariables.description: Phone number pairing: when set (international, symbol-free format, e.g. 4915112345678), an 8-character pairing code is logged to stderr on startup instead of relying on the QR code

environmentVariables.name: FFMPEG_PATH
environmentVariables.description: Path to an ffmpeg binary (only needed to override the ffmpeg installed automatically via the ffmpeg-static npm package)

environmentVariables.name: WA_WEB_VERSION
environmentVariables.description: webjs only: pin the WhatsApp Web version if a WhatsApp-side update breaks the client.

environmentVariables.name: HEALTH_CHECK_INTERVAL_MS
environmentVariables.description: webjs only: connection health check interval in milliseconds (<=0 disables)

environmentVariables.name: TOOL_READY_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: How long tool calls wait for the WhatsApp client to become ready before erroring

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_PORT
environmentVariables.description: When set, additionally exposes the MCP endpoint at http://127.0.0.1:<port>/mcp (Streamable HTTP) from the same process

environmentVariables.name: MCP_HTTP_HOST
environmentVariables.description: Bind address for the HTTP endpoint (do not expose publicly; the endpoint controls your personal WhatsApp account)

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OAUTH
environmentVariables.description: Use issued OAuth tokens on /mcp; every client requires explicit owner-authenticated consent.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_OPERATOR_TOKEN
environmentVariables.description: Required for every HTTP listener; 32–256 random URL-safe characters. Stdio does not require it.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_PUBLIC_URL
environmentVariables.description: Canonical HTTPS public origin for non-loopback HTTP or a reverse proxy. Preserve this Host upstream.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_ALLOWED_ORIGINS
environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated additional exact browser origins for HTTP. No wildcard or null origins.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_AUTO_CONNECT
environmentVariables.description: Set false for diagnostics that expose MCP without connecting to WhatsApp.

environmentVariables.name: MCP_TOOL_TIMEOUT_MS
environmentVariables.description: Tool deadline in milliseconds, 100–300000; sends already in flight may still complete.
